title: The per-tick gate also runs the full (non-short) tests of the packages a tick touched
description: epic-6in (2026-09-28): dz1's regression (tk 0.32.0 stopped refusing over-width claims → TestARunUnderANewRunIDIsOfferedThePreviousRunsReports and three more reconcile tests red) passed every per-tick gate, because the gate runs the short suite and those tests are end-to-end (newFixture skips under -short). It surfaced only at close-out in CI's full suite, costing a repair and two ~30-min CI cycles. Make the integrated gate additionally run ?   	github.com/pengelbrecht/ticfac	[no test files] (non-short, with -timeout and the gate's parallelism) for the Go packages whose files the tick changed, plus packages that import them if cheap to compute (go list -deps reverse); keep the whole-repo short suite as today. Bound it (a package's full suite can be 20+ min: reconcile) — decide per-package budgets or a cap, and justify. Evidence keyed as today so an unchanged package is a cache hit.
notes: 2026-10-08 00:21 - ticfac run epic-t8u: r1f try 1 (run dispatch #13) reported a finding the run itself decided — proposed-tick "Delete the gate's -leave-to-ci budget once reconcile's suite is affordable" (key f972591e04f44b4ed14cd069ad15593fdbc659bfd278c088d7567d551c3050fa, severity medium, for this repository) is promoted to a backlog tick with an owner, ez7; the decision record is on the run branch at .ticfac/runs/epic-t8u/absorptions/f972591e04f44b4ed14cd069ad15593fdbc659bfd278c088d7567d551c3050fa.json, and the draft is triaged as promoted.
acceptance_criteria: A tick that breaks an end-to-end test in a package it touched fails its per-tick gate (fixture reproducing dz1's shape); untouched packages' full suites are not run; gate time on a typical tick measured before/after and reported
